verdict.rationale: Scribe accepts a natural-language instruction (up to 2000 characters) that it applies to the final transcript and returns as 'edited_transcript'. ElevenLabs also documents an official MCP server, which lets AI assistants drive the product from natural-language requests. However, the in-product natural-language control is limited to post-editing transcripts, and nothing shows full operation of Scribe by natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural-language control beyond transcript editing (e.g. configuring or launching jobs), documentation that the MCP server exposes Scribe operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
